title: Balboa Fun Tours & Rentals
specs: Largest kayak fleet in Orange County
Calm waters of Newport Harbor and Back Bay ideal for beginners and families
Electric bikes have 250W motor and 21 miles range
Paddle boards provide full-body workout and are beginner-friendly
Children under 3 years old not permitted on kayaks or paddleboards
Children 3 and older welcome; under 18 must be accompanied by an adult on the water
Each paddler 4 years and older must occupy their own seat on a kayak
Children 12 and under must wear Coast Guard-approved life jackets at all times
Insurance covering $6500 equipment damage available for $5 per person, optional
Can accommodate large groups and offer discounted rates for bulk rentals or guided tours

blurb: Guests rent kayaks, paddle boards, electric bikes, and beach cruisers to explore Newport Harbor, Back Bay, and surrounding scenic routes. Guided tours are available for kayaking, paddleboarding, electric biking, and biking. Rentals include safety gear and orientation, with options for hourly, daily, and weekly durations.
extraNote: Parking cost $40; free and metered options available nearby with restrictions · Closing hours vary from 5-7pm; equipment must be returned 15 minutes before closing · Late return fee $20 per 30 minutes; after 24 hours no contact, full equipment cost charged ($250-$1500)
